description.narrative: Population in White Nile is classified as one of the most vulnerable communities in Sudan, The target school doesn’t have any WASH facilities this water shortage poses the health of students at greater public health risks and make another public health issues to their families due to unhygienic practice they do at their schools therefore, the water in the schools is important for anal cleansing, hand washing and drinking, The project aims to improve sanitation as well as facilitate improved knowledge and practice on personal hygiene and water usage, The proposed project will target 555 girls in Elhasania school with construction of 6 drop-hole toilets to improve the access to sanitation services this will prevent the children from doing open defecation and reduces the flies around the school the latrine will be built using VIP school latrines design with close coordination and collaboration with ministry of health and HAC. Other key intervention is connecting the school with the main water supply network in Kosti to enable the school have water available and they don’t have spent any more money in water once the water is available in the school children can use after using the latrines, before eating and for other person hygiene needs. These activities will be accompanied by hygiene promotion improve the awareness of the children 30 pupils will be trained in hygiene promotion and environmental awareness health club will be established to demonstrate the hygiene awareness amongst the pupils the club will have a weekly program supervised by a trained teacher with close monitoring from SIDO public health officer.
